svg.aria-label: Queen 2.3.0 at 3 million messages a second on one queue of 10 to 10 million partitions: push and end to end latency, and per node CPU, memory, disk writes and disk time a write
svg.text: Queen 2.3.0 at 3M msg/s: one queue, 10 to 10M partitions
Three GCP c4-standard-24-lssd brokers (24 vCPU, 88 GB, four local NVMe disks in RAID0), three 16-vCPU loaders · 2026-10-14
end to end = pushed until consumed
partitions in one queue (each step is 10 times the one before)

svg.text: A fresh three-node cluster for each point; 100 messages of 256 B a request (binary push, zstd), counts acks, framed pops; dedup off, nothing deleted.
Latency: nine load processes pooled, last 30 s of a 70 s step. Disk: /dev/md0 each second, mean of the last 30 s. Memory: the most the broker held.
100k: every number carried, but one pop of millions timed out (HTTP 503), so the harness marks the point not carried.
